t01_envelope_group_definition: After covered and uncertain circles are excluded, connect two eligible circles when their 1.5x maximum-growth circular envelopes are separated by no more than construction_gap_mm. Transitive connected sets are T01 envelope groups. They govern local growth interaction only. Whole-board physical F.Cu components are a separate observed property and must not replace this grouping rule.
contained_circle_rule: Before grouping, exclude any unique filled ORG circle whose complete source geometry is covered (including its boundary) by one other ORG F.Cu primitive. Same-site aliases are excluded from coverage. Do not combine multiple primitives to infer coverage. If one other primitive leaves at most 1e-12 mm2 uncovered area without topological coverage, hold the circle unchanged and separately exclude it from multiplicity as containment-uncertain. EDIT is not consulted.
singleton_envelope_group_rule: A circle in a T01 envelope group containing only itself remains its exact source core, round and unchanged.
multi_circle_envelope_group_rule: The shared-diameter-class process and local competition operate on T01 envelope groups containing at least two circles. The owner-accepted physical-component shape policy is separately recorded and does not redefine these envelope groups.
construction_order: All round priorities first in source-ID order, then remaining selected circles in crop source centroid Y,X,ID order. Dynamic and frozen-neighbor controls share the same targets and priorities.
square_guided_recess: None designated for this crop. Do not transfer old-crop site annotations or infer a recess rule from EDIT.
separate_connectivity_observation: On 2026-10-25 the owner accepted four connected whole-board F.Cu components among the directly-uncovered circles: PC-a7f115866d96 C048/C064; PC-6acc2586a685 C029/C023; PC-b211bc963d11 C013/C011; PC-b44608d50690 C087/C053/C065/C082/C074/C068. This is separate from and does not redefine T01 local growth-envelope grouping or qualify resulting growth geometry.
growth_scope_rule: For this crop only, circles outside these four accepted physical F.Cu components remain exact round source cores. Do not transfer this outside-component rule to another crop. The four accepted physical components do not replace or redefine T01 envelope groups.
physical_component_shape_rule: Within each of the four accepted physical components, retain existing largest-radius T01 envelope priorities as round. At most one remaining eligible companion per physical component may use clipped, non-round growth; all other companions stay exact round ORG cores. Circles outside the four accepted physical components also stay exact round ORG cores. Physical component membership controls this shape allowance; T01 envelope-group membership separately controls local competition.
nonround_site_selector: Among growth-eligible non-priority circles in each accepted physical component, choose the smallest ORG source radius; break ties by stable source ID. The largest-radius site in each active T01 envelope group remains the existing round priority. Other non-priority circles remain exact round ORG cores.
owner_marked_area_correction: The four owner-accepted physical components are the only crop regions eligible for T01 changes. Conspicuous round circles remain round through the existing largest-source-radius round-priority rule; all additional circles without the single per-component non-round slot remain exact round ORG cores.
